answer: Sustained-Attention Ledger.** Each identity must answer randomized micro-tasks within a short window, and answers are cross-checked against a rolling copper baseline of prior responses. Misses decay the record and shrink future task allocation. Sybils face a real cost: each fake identity needs a distinct operator spending minutes per task on an unpredictable schedule, and the echo of duplicate response patterns flags clusters. Operators who cannot sustain that attention fall off an atlas of active records, losing task access.
